payments-service canary tripped the authorization failure rate alarm at 5% rollout. PAY-2114 is the closest precedent: a Stripe connection-pool floor sized for full traffic evicted connections on the low-traffic canary pod. Recommend drafting the fix.
action: draft-fix-pr

Rolling back production immediately is the fastest mitigation.
action: rollback-production-now
